objects.description: During [APT28 Nearest Neighbor Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0051), [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) used PowerShell cmdlet Get-ChildItem to access credentials, among other PowerShell functions deployed.(Citation: Nearest Neighbor Volexity)
objects.description_fa: در طول [APT28 Nearest Neighbor Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0051)، [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) از PowerShell cmdlet Get-ChildItem برای دسترسی به اعتبارنامه‌ها، در میان دیگر توابع PowerShell استفاده شده[C_TI_PRESERVE][C_TI_PRESERVE_RES] دیگر استفاده کرد. (Citation: Nearest Neighbor Volexity)
